description: Labelled RAG evaluation set for TC-005 (Saba). Each query has the set of regulation_name values that a correct retrieval should surface, drawn from the 5-PDF corpus in research/regulations/ (GDPR, EU AI Act, Codigo Penal, Ley 13/2022, LOPDGDD). 'expected_regulations' is matched case-insensitively against the regulation_name metadata that query_regulations puts on each RegulationRef. 'corpus_regulations' is the closed set used for the hallucination check: any returned regulation not in this set is a hallucinated citation.
